newsitem.title: UK: Excite names TSMSi as UK sales agency.
newsitem.headline: Excite names TSMSi as UK sales agency.

text.p: TSMSi, the interactive arm of British television advertising sales house TSMS, on Monday said Excite Inc has named it as its UK sales agency.
Excite is a leading Internet navigation network. TSMS is a unit of United News & Media Plc and the largest airtime sales house in the UK for the ITV television network.
TSMSi, established in February to sell advertising on the Internet and other new media, said it will introduce Excite to major advertising planning and buying points.
Excite also said it named Anne Prendergast as European sales and marketing director. Prendergast was previously associate publisher at Wired UK. -- London Advertising Newsdesk +44 171 542 2815
